assignments.essential_function: Polish drafts and refresh existing copy with voice and evidence checks.

review: Seven ordered passes improve clarity, consistent voice, benefits, supporting proof, specificity, emotion and action friction; later passes revisit proof. Its own workflow includes author review and preservation of core intent. Simulated expert-panel scores are a writing aid, not independent expert certification.
